items.title: Roadmap: `uv audit`
items.reason: Maintainer comments explain that audit normally locks first and recommend --frozen to avoid interpreter downloads. This explains the workaround, but does not track ignored UV_PYTHON or ineffective target filters.

items.title: Make universal the default for `uv audit`
items.reason: Introduced the exact condition that skips interpreter discovery only for frozen audits without --python-version or --python-platform. It establishes the historical behavior, not a fix for interpreter overrides or target filtering.

items.title: Evaluate extras and groups when determining auditable packages
items.reason: Introduced lockfile traversal filtered by extras and dependency groups. Maintainer discussion supports auditing everything by default with explicit subset selection; the implementation does not supply Python/platform markers to that traversal.

related.search_scope: Searched astral-sh/uv open and closed issues and all PR states using audit, UV_PYTHON, --python, python-version, python-platform, frozen, and unexpected argument; separately searched interpreter/download behavior and marker/filtering concepts without package or platform restrictions. Reviewed audit-area issues, comments, referenced PRs, historical diffs, and audit-titled entries from the latest 4,000 PRs. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#18968 (UV_CONFIG_FILE precedence), astral-sh/uv#22089 and its merged fix astral-sh/uv#22090 (dependency-group selection), and astral-sh/uv#18970 (script handling and extras traversal). Additional targeted searches hit GitHub's rate limit; no exact duplicate or previous fix for these gaps was found in the retrieved evidence.

type_reason: Source confirms that audit supplies no explicit interpreter request, exposes no --python/UV_PYTHON binding, and computes but discards the markers from --python-version and --python-platform. The documented filtering behavior is therefore incorrect, independently of whether adding --python is viewed as an enhancement. Historical PRs concern universal defaults and group/extra filtering; no previously fixed target-filtering bug or exact duplicate was established.
summary: No exact duplicate found. astral-sh/uv#18506 and astral-sh/uv#18185 explain interpreter downloads and the frozen workaround; astral-sh/uv#18511 provides related subset-filtering history.
draft_response:
Your examples match the current implementation: audit has no --python/UV_PYTHON override, and the markers computed from --python-version and --python-platform are not used to select audited packages. The latter contradicts the documented behavior.

For now, your `uv audit --frozen --preview-features audit-command` workaround avoids interpreter discovery when neither target flag is supplied, but it does not provide a Python-specific audit. The normal locking/download behavior is explained in astral-sh/uv#18506.

The next step is to wire interpreter selection and target-marker filtering through audit, with regression coverage for both. Your reproductions already provide the necessary cases.
